standard_prerequisites.name: The geometric case of capping with a first Chern class
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, label lemma-geometric-cap, invoked at proof line 6924 and used repeatedly from proof line 6916 to 6923
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the successive caps c_1(O_P(1))^i cap pi^*[Z] with the cycle classes of the common zero schemes Z(s_1) intersect ... intersect Z(s_i) of the constructed rational sections.

core_obligations: Settle the case s < r - 1 by dimension: for an integral Z of delta-dimension k the pullback pi^*[Z] is the class of the integral pi^{-1}(Z) of dimension k + r - 1, and c_1(O_P(1))^s cap pi^*[Z] is represented by a cycle supported on pi^{-1}(Z) in dimension k + r - 1 - s strictly smaller than the fibre dimension, so its pushforward vanishes (proof lines 6886-6893).

Reduce the case s = r - 1 to a computation over the generic point of Z: the pushforward is n[Z] for some integer n, and by dimension reasons one may shrink X by a proper closed subset T of Z, choose elements e_1, ..., e_{r-1} of E_xi extending to part of a basis at the generic point, and obtain rational sections s_1, ..., s_{r-1} of O_P(1) on pi^{-1}(Z) whose common zero set is the image of a section Z -> pi^{-1}(Z) away from T (proof lines 6895-6914).

Compute the iterate: repeated application of the geometric case gives c_1(O_P(1))^i cap pi^*[Z] = [Z(s_1) intersect ... intersect Z(s_i)] on the shrunk base, hence c_1(O_P(1))^{r-1} cap pi^*[Z] is the class of the image of a section, whose pushforward by pi is visibly [Z]; this gives n = 1 for alpha a single integral class, and the author states that the passage to a general cycle is the same argument (proof lines 6915-6928).
proof_roadmap: Dispose of s < r - 1 by the dimension of the support of the representing cycle (proof lines 6886-6893).
Shrink the base and build rational sections whose common zero set is a section of the projective bundle (proof lines 6895-6914).
Iterate the geometric case and push forward the class of the image of the section to get n = 1 (proof lines 6915-6928).
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pushforward along a projective bundle of the self-caps of c_1(O_P(1)) applied to a pulled back cycle: it is zero in degrees below r - 1 and returns the original class in degree r - 1 (statement lines 6867-6883, tag 02TW). The proof needs a real construction for the critical degree: after shrinking the base by a proper closed subset it chooses elements of the fibre of E at the generic point extending to part of a basis, builds rational sections of O_P(1) whose common zero set is the image of a section of the bundle, and then iterates the geometric case of capping with a first Chern class to identify the successive caps with the cycle classes of these zero sets. The iteration and the section construction are the substance, so the claim is H2.
